summary: Funselektor Labs' stylized driving games, moving from minimalist drift training in Absolute Drift to the alternate-history rally celebration Art of Rally.

entries.title: Absolute Drift
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release / Zen Edition content where available

emulation.notes: Run natively on Windows at the highest stable settings.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC release at highest stable settings

primary.version: Current PC release / Zen Edition content where available
primary.why: Absolute Drift released first on Windows, OS X, and Linux, later appearing as Absolute Drift: Zen Edition on PlayStation 4 and Xbox One, then on iOS, Android, Apple TV, and Nintendo Switch. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible route for the minimalist drift game.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version at the highest stable settings; use console, Switch, mobile, or Apple TV versions only as access alternatives.

entries.remaster_caveats: Zen Edition is the console-era edition; verify the current PC build content if comparing exact feature parity.
